content.heading: Planet **Positive**
content.text: We believe in cleaning up after ourselves, over-compensating for any emissions and finding innovative ways to create greener productions.

stats.label: kg of CO2 emissions compensated
stats.more: From car rides, flights, down to the servers rendering our VFX shots, we track all our carbon emissions. We compensate an additional 50% of our total CO2 impact to help push things in the right direction.

stats.label: trees planted with Eden Project
stats.more:
We support the tireless efforts of Eden Projects who work with local communities to restore forests on a massive scale, creating jobs in the process, protecting ecosystems and helping to mitigate climate change.

We support their efforts in Madagascar which has seen large scale mangrove loss. Mangroves are a vital ecosystem for local communities as well as protection against climate change.
Visit [Studio Birthplace’s Tree Nation forest](https://tree-nation.com/profile/studio-birthplace)

stats.label: hectares of ecosystem restored
stats.more:
Through our tree planting efforts we want to make sure we don’t ‘plant trees’. Instead, we want to plant forests. It is critical to work with local knowledge to plant the right species, creating a proper ecosystem and making sure that the trees you plant actually survive the many challenges they face.

That is why we support [Eden Projects](https://www.edenprojects.org/)

content.text: We have to rewild the world, that much is obvious. But first, we must rewild the imagination. We must learn how to dream again, to dream of a just, healthy future.

items.title: Independence & Integrity
items.text: **Studio Birthplace is independent.** We stand firm with those who engage in meaningful action and avoid those who greenwash. We work with integrity, responsibility and rely on local knowledge to guide us in environments we are unfamiliar with.

items.title: Collaboration & Respect
items.text: **We believe in meaningful relationships** both within our tightly-knit, global team and with our clients. We combat discrimination and encourage equality and diversity amongst our team and crews on our productions.

items.title: Awareness to Social Inequity
items.text: We work all over the world and are blessed to meet many different cultures, religions and people from all walks of life. We are very cautious not to take advantage of local communities. Instead, **we look for ways to improve the lives of those we encounter.**
